batches.summary: The current batch of SINCOTECS officers serving the ITE student body at Davao Central College.
The founding batch under the revised CBL, establishing key programs and organizational structure.

officers.name: Cristian Silagan
officers.short_description: Head of the Local Council, implements programs & projects, presides over sessions.
officers.full_description: Shall be the head of the Local Council. Shall implement programs and projects in conformity with the needs of his college and with consent of the Local Council. Shall preside over sessions and meetings of the Local Council. Shall sign documents, laws, and policies of the Local Council. Shall be the official representative of his college. Shall see to it that orders, laws, and ordinances passed by the House of Senate and approved by the President of the DCC-CSSG will be properly implemented in his college. Shall submit monthly reports of the activities to the President of DCC-CSSG regarding the activities of his college. Shall create special committees and appoint its chairperson with the consent of the Committee on Appointments, whenever the need for immediate action arises. Shall be one of the signatories of the Local Council Bank Account. Shall present a Budget Appropriation subject for approval of the Representatives.

officers.name: Marielle A. Sarona
officers.short_description: Presiding Officer of the Representatives, assumes Governor duties in absence.
officers.full_description: Shall be the Presiding Officer of the Representatives. Shall assume all the duties and responsibilities of the Governor in cases of the latter's absence or disability. Shall perform such other duties and functions as the Governor may direct.

officers.name: Lemuel John G. Ibañez
officers.short_description: Manages meeting minutes, records, notices, and serves as property custodian.
officers.full_description: Shall take the minutes of all meetings called by the Local Council. Shall keep all the records of the Local Council. Shall issue calls and notices of all meetings. Shall render reports of all activities and status of the Local Council as the Governor may direct. Shall furnish copies and notices and communications to all offices concerned. Shall prepare the agenda of the Local Council meeting. Shall be the property custodian of the Local Council.

officers.name: Abigail Comedido
officers.short_description: Handles collections, bank signatories, disbursements, and financial reporting.
officers.full_description: Shall take charge of the collections of the Local Council. Shall be one of the signatories of the Local Council bank account. Shall disburse money upon the approval of the Local Legislative Body. Shall prepare semestral financial statement and report the same to the Local Auditor and the Governor. Shall take charge of the liquidations of its liabilities and submit the same to the School Auditing Officer. Shall perform such other duties and functions as the Local Council Governor may direct.

officers.name: Ryan Miguel Tonzo
officers.short_description: Audits accounts, receipts, expenditures, and ensures fiscal accountability.
officers.full_description: Shall audit accounts, receipts of and expenditures/uses of funds and property owned/held entrust by the Local Council. Shall make post auditing on all materials purchased by the Local Council and take charge of the liquidation of its liabilities and submit the same to the Auditing Officer. Shall perform such other duties and functions as the Local Council Governor may direct.

officers.name: Al Saif Musa
officers.short_description: Promotes organizational objectives, manages public image and communications.
officers.full_description: Shall popularize the thrust and objectives of the Local Council. Shall build and maintain a credible image for Local Council. Shall take charge of all the promotions of Local Council projects, activities, towards the school administrations, faculty, staff and students. Shall perform other duties and functions as the Local Council Governor may direct.

officers.name: Dhonna Lyne A. Chavez
officers.short_description: Enforces discipline, reviews code of conduct violations, and recommends actions.
officers.full_description: Reviewing alleged violations of the Code of Conduct and related policies. Conducting impartial hearings with fairness, transparency, and confidentiality. Making disciplinary recommendations that promote education, rehabilitation, and growth. Advising the organization on the development and revision of student conduct policies.

officers.name: Yasser I. Sabdullah
officers.short_description: Receives and investigates student complaints, represents student grievances.
officers.full_description: Caters/entertains any kind of complaint or grievances brought to its disposition. Conducts investigations in coordination with the proper personnel. Submits a recommendatory decision to the House of Senate which will review the case. Assists or represents student complaint and grievance to the Office of Student Affairs and Services (OSAS).

officers.name: Christopher Bryan G. Royo
officers.short_description: Plans and executes fundraising activities and resource generation strategies.
officers.full_description: The Ways and Means Committee is one of the special committees appointed by the Governor. It is responsible for planning and implementing fundraising programs, managing the collection of membership fees and dues, and identifying revenue-generating projects. All fund collections within SINCOTECS must be documented through an approved resolution.
officers.photo: /assets/officers/CHRISTOPHER BRYAN G. ROYO - WAYS AND MEANS.jpg

officers.name: Raven Kurt Tanaka
officers.short_description: Handles special tasks and temporary assignments as required by the council.
officers.full_description: The Adhoc Committee is a special committee created by the Governor with the consent of the Committee on Appointments, whenever the need for immediate action arises. The committee handles special, temporary assignments and tasks that fall outside the scope of the standing committees, ensuring flexibility in addressing urgent organizational needs.

officers.name: Jasmine Duran
officers.short_description: Manages event logistics, materials, equipment, and venue coordination.
officers.full_description: The Logistics Committee is a special committee appointed by the Governor. It manages the procurement, preparation, and arrangement of materials, equipment, and venues for organizational events and activities. The committee ensures that all logistical requirements are fulfilled for the smooth execution of SINCOTECS programs and projects.

officers.name: Jennyvieve Mahinay
officers.short_description: Leads project execution, coordinates working committees for organizational events.
officers.full_description: The Working Head Committee is a special committee created by the Governor. It leads the on-the-ground execution of organizational projects and activities, coordinating between the different committees to ensure that goals are met on schedule and that all aspects of event planning and execution are covered.

officers.name: Jezylae Villarino Gines
officers.short_description: Represents 1st year BSIT students in the Local Council and advocates for their interests.
officers.full_description: The 1st Year Representative serves as the voice of first-year BSIT students in the SINCOTECS Local Council. They attend council meetings, relay student concerns, participate in legislative deliberations, and ensure that the needs and interests of their batch are represented in organizational decisions and policies.
